name: io.github.Servosity/superops-mcp
title: SuperOps MCP
description: Every SuperOps PSA+RMM entity in your terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN credential for the SuperOps MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the SuperOps API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Data-centre region your tenant lives in: us or eu. The wrong region answers with an authentication error.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your tenant subdomain (SuperOps: Settings > MSP Information). Sent as the CustomerSubdomain header on every call; requests without it are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to save no API data locally: sync and workflow archive are refused and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to SuperOps. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
